claim: Both ledger targets are resolved to the extent the Lean evidence supports: rank 0 (the NonarchimedeanRing Q_p instance) is closed and unblocks four previously unstatable lemmas of the nonarchimedean infinite-sum kit, without touching the p-adic log/exp gap; rank 1 (the Ind1-3 allowed-operation family) is formalized as a relation provably strictly smaller than the ambient A(k) family, with composition closure proved only under explicit hypotheses and refuted for the raw generator family. The ledger wording required six corrections, one substantive: its literal projection formula is false. Green gates certify process integrity of this audit, not mathematical admission.
dissent: The rank-1 model is faithful in shape only: a Fin 4 slot tuple over Q_p is not a Hodge theater, and a safety property for a toy relation says nothing about the real Ind1-3 procession.
Rank 0 closes a typeclass obligation, not a gap in IUT: the log/exp obstruction is untouched, and my own brief was wrong about which consequences the instance implies.
The verification nodes share one checker implementation, so a defect there would satisfy every gate at once: independence is procedural, not semantic.
